title: Rat-brain neurons fly an F-22 simulator

tellings.quote: Google uh rat brain F-22 and it's from the University of Southern California, Southern Florida. And it's a guy doing he takes 20,000 neurons of a rat brain,

plain: Around 2004, a scientist in Florida is said to have taken about 20,000 neurons from a rat's brain, grown them in a dish, and used them to fly a simulator of the F-22 fighter jet. A researcher named Grant Cameron tells Michels to "Google rat brain F-22", unsure whether it came from the University of Southern California or a Florida university. He brings it up as proof that living brain cells can be wired to control machines.
